old_card.headline: Apollo group firm IDL commissions 9,000 MT bulk explosives silo near Asansol
old_card.takeaway: Adds delivery capacity for IDL's Coal India bulk explosives orders, but no cost, revenue or timeline is disclosed, so the earnings effect cannot be sized.
old_card.core_catalyst: Silo capacity at the mine head serving Eastern and Central Coalfields bulk explosives orders

what_happened.text: **IDL Explosives**, a group company, commissioned the **Bolkunda Silo Unit**, a bulk explosives silo plant of **9,000 MT** capacity on **8.4 acres** near Asansol, West Bengal.
what_happened.quote: IDL Explosives Limited (“IDL”), a group company of Apollo Micro Systems Limited, has commissioned the Bolkunda Silo Unit, a new bulk explosives silo plant with a capacity of 9,000 MT, spread over 8.4 acres of land near Asansol, West Bengal.

what_happened.text: The unit will supply site-mixed bulk explosives to **Eastern Coalfields Limited, Central Coalfields Limited** and other regional customers.
what_happened.quote: Located in the heart of the Eastern Coal Belt and the Central Coal Belt, the Bolkunda Silo Unit will serve the mining operations of Eastern Coalfields Limited, Central Coalfields Limited and other customers in the region with site-mixed bulk explosives.

what_happened.text: The filing ties the plant to **long-term bulk explosives orders secured from Coal India subsidiaries earlier this year**.
what_happened.quote: The new plant expands IDL's national network of bulk explosives plants and silos, and strengthens the company's capacity to service the long-term bulk explosives orders secured from Coal India subsidiaries earlier this year.

why_it_matters.text: IDL is a group company, not a listed subsidiary in memory's entity list; the filing gives no project cost, so the spend cannot be weighed against Apollo's ₹1,313 Cr net worth.
Memory has IDL inside the consolidated order book (₹480 Cr of ₹1,704 Cr in August), so silo capacity feeds a business already counted in group revenue.
Peers are also commissioning capacity this month (Quality Power's Sangli coil plant, GRP's solar units); this is a small operational step, not a group-level re-rating event.

what_happened.text: Number of solar pumps installed in H1FY27 rose **29.3% YoY** to **51,543 units**.
what_happened.quote: Solar Pumps Installed, H1 FY27 51,543 +29.3% YoY

what_happened.text: H1FY27 EBITDA fell to **₹1,469 Mn** with margin contracting to **9.2%**.
what_happened.quote: EBITDA 1,469 EBITDA Margins % 9.2% in H1 FY27

what_happened.text: Order book stood at **₹7,510 Mn** (₹751 Cr) as of October 23, 2026.
what_happened.quote: Our order book stood at ₹ 7,510 Mn as of 23rd October 2026.

why_it_matters.text: EBITDA margins were impacted by lower realisations, higher raw material costs and elevated logistics expenses due to geopolitical conditions.
why_it_matters.quote: Margins during the period moderated due to lower realisations, higher raw material costs and elevated logistics expenses linked to prevailing geopolitical conditions.

why_it_matters.text: Trial production commenced for 0.5 GW of the planned 2.2 GW solar module capacity in October 2026.
why_it_matters.quote: I am happy to share that 0.5 GW of our planned 2.2 GW solar module capacity has commenced trial production in October 2026, with the 2.2 GW DCR solar cell facility to be commissioned by FY28.

what_happened.text: Solar pump installations reached **51,543 units** in H1FY27, up **29.3% YoY**.
